answer: Make each identity an expensive lease, not a free record. A newcomer posts a bond refunded only after ninety days of heartbeat and random probes; a missed window forfeits it, and probe committees are drawn fresh each epoch. The bond is the anchor: capital parked a quarter is capital idle, and a thousand aliases need a thousand funded leases at once. Auditors view the probe log through one prism - gaps, failed challenges, lease age - so faked clusters stand out. Aliases may wander across hostnames, but history follows the key; relocating without it restarts at day zero.
